scope: SP05.1 independent fixed financial fixtures and full normalized-effect comparison utility. No raw receipt authentication, local ledger execution or public admission.

findings.title: Changed role bindings pass comparison
findings.reproduction: Set observed.deploymentBinding.roles.lender.logicalId = 'attacker' on a clone of loan.json. Compare the unchanged loan fixture against observed.
findings.reason: compareRecords compares role names only. It never compares role logicalId or status values. Source pin values are also ignored. The fixed expected fixture therefore cannot detect a changed counterparty binding.
requiredChanges: Compare every role record field and enforce consistency with stage role references.
Bind source pins to the admitted expected record or explicitly separate unauthenticated annotations from the checked record.
Add changed logicalId and setup-mint status controls on either input.

findings.title: Malformed nested JSON crashes the API
findings.reproduction: For separate loan clones: delete stages[2].economicFee, set stages[2]=null, or set deploymentBinding.roles=null. Compare each clone against the intact fixture.
observed: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'actor')
TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'stage')
TypeError: Cannot convert undefined or null to object
findings.reason: validateRecord returns shallow container success despite nested validation errors. compareRecords and compareStage then dereference malformed fields.
requiredChanges: Gate replay and comparison on complete structural validation.
Return deterministic structured errors for nested missing, null, primitive and malformed array items.
Test malformed expected inputs as well as observed inputs.

findings.title: Equal contradictory financial records pass
findings.reproduction: Apply each mutation to a fixture clone. Compare that clone against an identical clone.
findings.observed: Every listed mutation returned ok:true with no errors.

counterexamples.mutation: At settle set nominalRemaining and outstandingNotional to 0 and residualDuties to [].
At accrue set interestCalculated to 1, keeping interestDue and the emitted interest due at 33972602.
At accrue set principal due outstanding to 1, keeping created and principal.due at 500000000.
At accrue set borrower pre and post cash to 1, keeping setup post and settle pre cash at 20000000000.
At swap set economicFee.amount to 31, keeping trader fee at 30 and all transfers unchanged.
At swap set trader ASSET_A actor effect fee to 0, keeping economicFee.amount at 30.
At close set work=100 and revision=77, keeping remaining=6 and lifetime=8.

findings.reason: Replay covers only stage-local balances and gross/incoming amounts. It does not validate inter-stage continuity, liability allocation, source arithmetic, lifecycle rules, residual duties or fee reconciliation.
requiredChanges: Validate both records against the admitted fixed source-derived economic trace.
Reconcile due creation, settlement, paid amounts and retained notional across stages.
Check revision plus remaining against lifetime and enforce one decrement per action.
Reconcile economic fee fields with actor fee effects and the fixed swap calculation.
Preserve the separate unresolved network fee accounting.

findings.title: Missing financial coverage can bypass replay
findings.reproduction: At loan settle set actorEffects=[] on both inputs. Alternatively set balances={pre:[],post:[]} and actorEffects=[] on both inputs while preserving the transfer.
findings.reason: Replay checks only rows that exist. It does not require balances and effects for transfer participants. Only explicit setup minting can justify an external source without a balance row.
additionalObservedCases: Equal swap clones accept duplicate transfer ordinal 0 at close.
Equal loan clones accept a duplicate borrower in bindings.roles.
Equal loan clones accept quantum 0 across deployment and stage bindings.
requiredChanges: Require complete participant/asset balance and actor-effect coverage for each fixed stage.
Limit the synthetic mint source exception to the declared setup transfers.
Reject duplicate role identities and duplicate or invalid transfer ordinals.
Require positive quantum and consistent bindings.

findings.title: Embedded test output does not match declared digests
findings.reason: The GREEN output includes an explicit omitted-header summary. Neither embedded UTF-8 output hashes to its declared outputSha256. Independent rerun still confirms 29 passes.
requiredChanges: Add an amendment identifying exact raw captures and their verifiable digests.
Label summaries as summaries and give their own digest.

fixtureInspection.status: Source-derived fixed fixture values reconciled. This does not approve the comparison implementation.
fixtureInspection.method: Manual comparison to pinned .mori sources plus independent Python integer and field assertions. No evaluator or kernel output used.
checkedGroups: loan: source pins, agreement, role records, network labels, economic fee, every liability/accrual/due/residual field, and every ordered transfer checked against independent source-derived values
swap: source pins, agreement, role records, network labels, economic fee, every liability/accrual/due/residual field, and every ordered transfer checked against independent source-derived values
fixtureInspection.additionalChecks: 516 field assertions checked all stage balance rows, actor effects, asset bindings and lifecycle values. Both complete fixture JSONs were read. Descriptive notes and synthetic IDs were inspected as annotations.

loan.dueSemantics: created and settled are stage effect amounts. Outstanding is post-stage state.

swap.reservation: One action allowance, discharged at close. No extra decrement.

fixtureInspection.schemaLimit: No signed delta fields exist. UInt128 bounds are applicable. No SInt128 implementation is claimed.
